answer: Make each new agent stake a slice of its first earnings into a shared lagoon that only drains back to it after peers it has never transacted with confirm its work over several epochs. A sybil farm can mint a thousand identities, but each sits on a separate timber raft of unproven history, and graders who keep finding the same quartz-hard phrasing across those rafts can freeze the whole cluster's pooled stake at once.
